description: AI-powered bulk eBay listing creation using Gemini Vision, real eBay comps, and direct EPS draft submission

recentWork.summary: Complete project audit and overhaul: Two-stage grouping pipeline, real eBay market comps, eBay Picture Services upload, IndexedDB draft persistence, and Vitest test suite
changesCompleted: Phase 1: Two-Stage Listing Pipeline (Stage 1 AI grouping -> Stage 2 Group review/edit gate -> Stage 3 Comps & listing generation)
Phase 2: Real eBay Comps Engine via eBay Browse API + fallback scraper with outlier-trimmed pricing
Phase 3: Real eBay Picture Services upload (UploadSiteHostedPictures base64 XML API) replacing fake image URLs
Phase 4: eBay Commerce Taxonomy leaf category resolution and seller business policies integration
Phase 5: Client-side IndexedDB persistence for photos, groups, and listings across page refreshes
Phase 6: Extracted ListingCard component from monolithic PhotoGroupDisplay and resolved all ESLint warnings (0 errors, 0 warnings)
Phase 7: Added Vitest test suite with 8 unit tests covering pricing, grouping normalization, dirty-group diffing, and taxonomy resolution
Phase 8: Design-eval audit passing 10/10 with crisp 3-step pipeline header and no AI slop

architecture.page.tsx: Two-stage pipeline state machine hydrating from IndexedDB with dirty-group regeneration

hooks.usePhotos: Photo array backed by IndexedDB Blobs and object URLs with unmount cleanup
hooks.useGrouping: Two-stage workflow hook: startGrouping -> generateListingsForGroups -> refreshListingComps
hooks.useGroupEditing: Group editing state machine (split, merge, modify photo membership)
hooks.useEbaySubmission: eBay submission with EPS photo upload and draft creation

components.AppHeader: 3-stage pipeline visual stepper with eBay connection status pill and auto-saved badge
components.UploadStep: Unified drag-and-drop zone with HEIC support and capability overview
components.GroupEditor: Stage 2 confirmation screen with photo reordering and group splitting/merging
components.PhotoGroupDisplay: Stage 3 listings container with batch value calculation and Seller Hub CSV export
components.ListingCard: Modular listing item card with market comps provenance and live price refresh

lib.storage/draftStore.ts: IndexedDB store for draft recovery and offline resilience
lib.ebay/comps.ts: eBay Browse API comp search and outlier-trimmed pricing stats
lib.ebay/client.ts: Commerce Taxonomy API leaf lookup and Account policy resolution
lib.logger.ts: Structured millisecond lifecycle logger flushing to logs/ebay-lister.log

techStack.ebay: eBay Inventory API + Trading EPS + Commerce Taxonomy + Browse APIs
